subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Oliver's grades improved, but more importantly, he stopped blaming himself.”?
options: People cannot change a habit they cannot see.
Information can change behavior when it is clear, personal, and connected to choices people can actually make.
A clear view can change more than what the eyes see.
She learned that giving up one view can sometimes help you see another.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「People cannot change a habit they cannot see.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Information can change behavior when it is clear, personal, and connected to choices people can actually make.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Oliver's grades improved, but more importantly, he stopped blaming himself. A clear view can change more than what the eyes see.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
